captions.detailed: A household countertop blender featuring a grey, tapered rectangular base with a black control panel and dial. Mounted on top is a large, semi-transparent cylindrical jar with a black handle and a thick black lid. Inside the jar sits a metallic six-blade assembly designed to rotate on a continuous vertical axis.
captions.instruction: Generate a high-performance household blender with a tapered base, a large cylindrical jar, a black handle, a thick lid, and a six-blade assembly rotating on a continuous joint.
captions.factory: Construct a tapered rectangular base using a lofted or extruded profile, adding a control panel box and a cylindrical dial. Create a semi-transparent cylindrical jar with a hollow center, a black base ring, and a rectangular handle. Model a thick cylindrical lid with radial grooves. Build a six-blade assembly with angled rectangular blades, and connect it to the jar base using a continuous joint.
